title: Assertion: Power-Down Sequencing
constraints: Power-down: when `pwr_en` falls, `iso_en` must already have been high for at least one cycle, and a `save` pulse must have occurred while isolated.
Power-up: `iso_en` may only fall when `pwr_en` has been high for at least 2 cycles and a `restore` pulse occurred after power came back.
Report a violation with a failing assertion (or `$error`). Legal traces must produce no error. `rst` is active high; ignore everything while it is asserted.
hints: Track `saved` (set by `save` while `iso_en`, cleared when isolation ends) and `restored` (set by `restore` while `pwr_en`, cleared when power drops), then assert `$fell(pwr_en) |-> saved` and `$fell(iso_en) |-> pwr_en && $past(pwr_en) && restored`.
These are the checks UPF-driven power-aware simulation performs automatically. Here you write them by hand.

examples.title: ok
examples.input: iso, save, power off … power on, restore, iso off
